facts.name: Julie C. Johnson
facts.assignment: Baker all county matters, truancy and shelter hearings; county judge since January7,2025.

procedure_checklist.communications: Email assistant; case number/name/matter in subject; copy parties. Follow-up permitted after48hours.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Email case number/style, motion copy,total requested time and whether opposition represented. Time confirmed only by assistant; additional matters require approval. File/serve notice promptly with ADA notice and remote credentials; send assistant copy. Notify assistant and file/serve cancellation.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Confer on evidentiary stipulations; no separate general civil motion conferral requirement established in reviewed page.
procedure_checklist.motions: File motion; orders await clerk docketing/imaging. Late continuance may remain undecided; appear unless order entered.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Portal only; prescribed DDDD/JJJJ/MMMM/CCCC/AAAA coding. Submit within10days after hearing unless instructed otherwise. Non-email-service parties: provide blank stamped envelopes identified by case; urgent uploaded order alert by email.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: General hearing materials three business days before; authority for evidentiary proceedings PDF by email two business days before and hard copy at hearing. Exhibits under50pages may email; over50pages mail tabbed binder/folder three days before. Preserve exact50page gap and timing differences.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Small claims,county civil and traffic solely Zoom unless in-person request to assistant at least24hours before. Obtain credentials from assistant. General remote-request paragraph says motion48hours before; docket-specific text retained separately.
procedure_checklist.civil_trial_setting: File notice for trial and notify assistant; coordinate date. No case-specific dates analyzed.
procedure_checklist.ai_statement: Undated individual page requires disclosure of AI use in filed papers and certification that each legal/record citation was verified. Preserved as published statement, not a conclusion about current controlling statewide requirements.

conflicts: General hearing-material deadline is three business days; evidentiary authority paragraph separately says two business days. Both retained without deciding precedence.
Exhibit routing covers less than50 and more than50pages; exactly50 is unspecified.
General remote paragraph requests motion48hours before; county civil paragraph provides Zoom default with24hour in-person request. Separate scopes retained.
facts.review_scope: Contacts,assignment and practical civil operating requirements reviewed. Full procedure HTML collected; criminal plea/probation/trial details and linked forms not substantively reviewed. No source conflict resolution.
